query.name: ca.myblueprint.dem.shsmstatus
query.description: SHSM enrolment and status for myBlueprint (SHSMStatus.txt format)
query.sql: WITH cfg AS ( SELECT '' AS school_ids ,'%SHSM%' AS program_name_pattern ,1 AS exclude_brd_res_9 ,0 AS exclude_future_entries FROM dual ) SELECT TO_CHAR(st.STUDENT_NUMBER) AS a_StudentID ,CASE WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Agricultur%' THEN 'Agriculture' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Arts%' THEN 'Arts and Culture' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Aviation%' THEN 'Aviation and Aerospace' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Business%' THEN 'Business' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Construction%' THEN 'Construction' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Energy%' THEN 'Energy' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Environment%' THEN 'The Environment' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Forestry%' THEN 'Forestry' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Health%' THEN 'Health and Wellness' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Horticult%' THEN 'Horticulture and Landscaping' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Hospitality%' THEN 'Hospitality and Tourism' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Information%' THEN 'Information and Communications Technology' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Justice%' THEN 'Justice, Community Safety, and Emergency Services' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Manufactur%' THEN 'Manufacturing' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Mining%' THEN 'Mining' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Non%Profit%' THEN 'NonProfit' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Sport%' THEN 'Sports' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Transport%' THEN 'Transportation' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Food%' THEN 'Food Processing' END AS b_Sector ,CASE WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Agricultur%' THEN '4' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Arts%' THEN '5' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Aviation%' THEN '6' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Business%' THEN '7' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Construction%' THEN '8' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Energy%' THEN '9' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Environment%' THEN '10' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Forestry%' THEN '11' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Health%' THEN '12' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Horticult%' THEN '13' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Hospitality%' THEN '14' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Information%' THEN '15' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Justice%' THEN '16' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Manufactur%' THEN '17' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Mining%' THEN '18' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Non%Profit%' THEN '19' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Sport%' THEN '20' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Transport%' THEN '21' WHEN g.NAME LIKE '%Food%' THEN '22' END AS c_SectorID ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS d_Pathway ,CASE WHEN xs.SHSM_PROGRAM_DATE IS NOT NULL AND xs.SHSM_PROGRAM_DATE <> TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN 'C' ELSE 'E' END AS e_Status ,TO_CHAR(sp.ENTER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS f_DateEnrolled ,CASE WHEN xs.SHSM_PROGRAM_DATE <> TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN TO_CHAR(xs.SHSM_PROGRAM_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS g_DateCompleted ,CASE WHEN xs.SHSM_EXPERIENTIAL_DATE IS NULL OR xs.SHSM_EXPERIENTIAL_DATE = TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS h_ELA ,CASE WHEN xs.SHSM_REACHAHEAD_DATE IS NULL OR xs.SHSM_REACHAHEAD_DATE = TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS i_ReachAhead ,CASE WHEN xs.SHSM_SKILLDEV_DATE IS NULL OR xs.SHSM_SKILLDEV_DATE = TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS j_OSP ,CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(1)) AS k_CLA ,'0' AS l_IEP ,TO_CHAR(st.SCHOOLID) AS m_SchoolCode ,TO_CHAR(NVL(xs.SPC_CODING, 0)) AS n_SpccCoding ,TO_CHAR(NVL(xs.SPC_INNOVATION, 0)) AS o_SpccInnovation ,TO_CHAR(NVL(xs.SPC_MATHLIT, 0)) AS p_SpccMathLit FROM STUDENTS st LEFT JOIN cfg ON 1=1 INNER JOIN SPENROLLMENTS sp ON sp.STUDENTID = st.ID INNER JOIN GEN g ON g.ID = sp.PROGRAMID AND g.CAT = 'specprog' AND g.NAME LIKE cfg.program_name_pattern LEFT JOIN S_ON_SEN_X xs ON xs.SPENROLLMENTSDCID = sp.DCID LEFT JOIN S_ON_STU_X x ON x.STUDENTSDCID = st.DCID WHERE st.ENROLL_STATUS IN (0, -1) AND (cfg.school_ids IS NULL OR INSTR(',' || REPLACE(cfg.school_ids, ' ', '') || ',', ',' || st.SCHOOLID || ',') > 0) AND (cfg.exclude_brd_res_9 = 0 OR NVL(TO_CHAR(x.BRD_RES_STATUS), 'x') <> '9') AND (cfg.exclude_future_entries = 0 OR st.ENTRYDATE <= SYSDATE) AND (sp.EXIT_DATE IS NULL OR sp.EXIT_DATE = TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') OR sp.EXIT_DATE > SYSDATE OR (xs.SHSM_PROGRAM_DATE IS NOT NULL AND xs.SHSM_PROGRAM_DATE <> TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SPENROLLMENTS sp3 INNER JOIN STUDENTS st3 ON st3.ID = sp3.STUDENTID LEFT JOIN S_ON_SEN_X xs3 ON xs3.SPENROLLMENTSDCID = sp3.DCID WHERE st3.STUDENT_NUMBER = st.STUDENT_NUMBER AND sp3.PROGRAMID = sp.PROGRAMID AND sp3.DCID <> sp.DCID AND (sp3.EXIT_DATE IS NULL OR sp3.EXIT_DATE = TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') OR sp3.EXIT_DATE > SYSDATE OR (xs3.SHSM_PROGRAM_DATE IS NOT NULL AND xs3.SHSM_PROGRAM_DATE <> TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))) AND ( CASE WHEN xs3.SHSM_PROGRAM_DATE IS NOT NULL AND xs3.SHSM_PROGRAM_DATE <> TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END > CASE WHEN xs.SHSM_PROGRAM_DATE IS NOT NULL AND xs.SHSM_PROGRAM_DATE <> TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END OR (CASE WHEN xs3.SHSM_PROGRAM_DATE IS NOT NULL AND xs3.SHSM_PROGRAM_DATE <> TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = CASE WHEN xs.SHSM_PROGRAM_DATE IS NOT NULL AND xs.SHSM_PROGRAM_DATE <> TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AND (NVL(sp3.ENTER_DATE, TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) > NVL(sp.ENTER_DATE, TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) OR (NVL(sp3.ENTER_DATE, TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = NVL(sp.ENTER_DATE, TO_DATE('1900-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) AND sp3.DCID > sp.DCID))) ) ) ORDER BY st.STUDENT_NUMBER, c_SectorID
